subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the open conflicting fork PR for this Debug Snapshots fix, or close that path and let a fresh narrow OpenClaw fix proceed from this issue?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but an open fork PR still references the issue with the same stale conflicting head, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue against current main.

options.title: Adopt and rebase fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch, repair the current Debug page/i18n/test shape, and provide visual proof before review.

recommendation.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest mix of original Debug surface history and recent adjacent Control UI connection-state work.
